# RemoteCast (chrome-stream-mcp)

> Low-bandwidth native Rust Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) screencast relay, interactive browser controller, and SEP-1865 MCP App server for viewing and controlling local Google Chrome tabs over slow or remote connections. Homepage: https://remotecast.eatingdream.dev

## For AI Agents

- [AI & Configuration Guide](docs/ai-guide.md): Complete MCP tool schemas (`chrome_stream_stage`, `chrome_stream_connect`, `chrome_stream_disconnect`, plus app-only tools), Standby vs. Revoke semantics, isolated Remote Chrome mode, weak-net profiles, `CHROME_STREAM_*` env vars, CLI flags, and build steps.
- [Agent Skill](skills/chrome-stream/SKILL.md): Concise `agentskills.io`-compatible operational workflow for agents.
- [Contributor & Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Architecture, Cargo/panel verification gates, loopback security boundaries, and plugin packaging rules.
- [README (English)](README.md) | [README (简体中文)](README.zh-CN.md)

## Quick Install (macOS / Linux)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

## Public MCP Tools

- `chrome_stream_stage`: Opens the live viewer (`ui://chrome-stream-mcp/stage`) and reports relay/Chrome readiness without auto-connecting.
- `chrome_stream_connect`: Connects to local Chrome (`mode?: "auto" | "personal" | "remote"`, `qualityPreset?: "auto" | "ultra" | "low" | "medium" | "high"`, `rttMs?`) and streams the active tab.
- `chrome_stream_disconnect`: Supports `mode?: "standby" | "revoke"` (default `"revoke"`). `"standby"` pauses at 0 FPS while keeping Chrome authorization alive; `"revoke"` closes the CDP WebSocket.

## App-Only MCP Tools (SEP-1865 UI Hosts)

- `chrome_stream_frame`: Long-polls adaptive motion JPEG or crisp settled WebP stills with 0-byte unchanged deduplication.
- `chrome_stream_input`: Dispatches coalesced inputs bound to `(targetId, targetEpoch)` with stale-target rejection.
- `chrome_stream_launch_remote`: Launches or reuses an isolated loopback Remote Chrome (`127.0.0.1`, `0700` profile) without requiring local Allow confirmation.

## CLI Subcommands

- `chrome-stream-mcp serve [--data-dir <path>] [--panel-html <path>]`
- `chrome-stream-mcp relay [--data-dir <path>]`
- `chrome-stream-mcp doctor [--json]`
